apply_verify.err.diverged: Apply was stopped: the model is kept as it was
apply_verify.rolled_back: Apply did not match the draft and was taken back; the model is unchanged. {what}
apply_verify.diff.missing: The draft shows {what} {kind}, but Apply did not do it.
apply_verify.diff.extra: Apply {kind} {what}, which the draft does not show.
apply_verify.diff.kind: The draft shows {what} {shown}, but Apply {applied} it.
apply_verify.diff.value: {what}: “{col}” came out different from the draft.
apply_verify.diff.truncated: The draft and the applied change differ in size.
apply_verify.diff.unreadable: The applied change could not be read back ({e}).
apply_verify.no_base: Apply was not run: the copy to check the draft against is missing. The model is unchanged; ask for the draft again.
apply_verify.take_back_failed: Taking it back failed ({e}): use Undo.
